title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on products mentioned in the provided sources. The Roborock Saros Z70 appears in two sources, giving it the strongest support. Other arms are listed from Dobot and Elephant Robotics catalogs.
assumptions: No price information was used except where explicitly stated; all price mentions were omitted per instructions.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want a robot vacuum that can also pick up small items. It offers strong vacuuming, mopping, and an OmniGrip arm, but the arm still struggles with some objects.
